title: Winter Host vs Glandore Breakers
lede:
Glandore Breakers won 31-14 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4, passing the 30 VP target in the last Cleanup Phase with the centre, the right objective and three missions.

The Sidhe got to the objectives first: 12 objective VP in the first two rounds, all three objectives in Round 2, while the Winter Host's first objective VP came in Round 3, and by then it trailed 2-16.
result_line: Glandore Breakers win 31-14 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The Winter Host set up on row 12 in front of its HQ at (7,13): Rurik the Deathless with the Rynda Guard and the Firelance Druzhina on the left at (3,12) and (4,12), Veche Levy 1, 2 and 3 at (5,12), (9,12) and (11,12), and the Winter Witch with the Bogatyr Thunderguards at (10,12). Glandore Breakers set up on rows 1 and 2 around its HQ at (7,1): Cliodhna - The Dread Tide with Sidhe Wardens 1 at (9,2), the Fey Lord with Sidhe Wardens 2 at (5,2), Sidhe Wardens 3 at (7,2), Morrigan's Chosen at (10,2), the Briton Yeomen at (4,2) and (11,2), and the Fomorian Tidebreaker at (3,1). The Winter Host had Priority every round with fewer units on the battlefield, but the Sidhe squads move further, and that decided who stood on the objectives first.

1.title: The Sidhe take the centre and the left

feed.text: Primaries revealed: ERADICATE THE FOE for the Winter Host, BREAK THEIR HOLD for Glandore. Secondaries kept: BAR THE GATES and INTO THE FRAY. The Winter Host spent its 2 CP on Double Time for Veche Levy 3, which bought nothing. Glandore's Flow of Magic rolled Tree.

Most units Advanced. Veche Levy 3 reached (7,8), at the centre's edge, but the Rynda Guard (3 Movement Points) and Veche Levy 1 (3) stopped at (2,9) and (4,10). Glandore went further: Sidhe Wardens 1 with Cliodhna to (6,6) on the centre, Sidhe Wardens 2 with the Fey Lord to (1,7) on the left objective, Morrigan's Chosen to (8,6), the Fomorian Tidebreaker to (3,6), and Sidhe Wardens 3 out to (13,6).

The Bogatyr Thunderguards shot Sidhe Wardens 3 for 1 and PARALYZED it; its FADING STEP took it back to (12,2). The Fomorian Tidebreaker's Baleful Eye took 6 off the Rynda Guard (15 to 9). The Winter Witch channelled 4 Mana.
Glandore held the centre on OC 17 vs 10 and the left on OC 11 vs 0, 5 VP. BAR THE GATES paid the Winter Host 2 (no enemy unit in its half). 2-5.

2.title: Thunderguards shot down; Glandore holds all three

feed.text: Glandore spent 2 CP on Double Time for Briton Yeomen 2 (its move to (10,5) was out of reach without it); the Winter Host passed with 2 CP. Secondaries kept: IRON GRIP and FOCUSED FIRE.

The Rynda Guard declared a charge on the Fomorian Tidebreaker; Glandore answered with Countercharge via the HQ (3 CP), the Tidebreaker charged Rurik and the Rynda Guard at (2,8) instead and the Rynda Guard's charge was cancelled. That completed INTO THE FRAY (+2). Veche Levy 2 stepped to (6,8) and took five Overwatches (Sidhe Wardens 2 did 4); the Veche Levies' Overwatch put 3 into Briton Yeomen 1 as it came to (7,6). The Bogatyr Thunderguards and the Winter Witch moved to (8,8) under Go to Ground (1 CP). Sidhe Wardens 3 walked onto the right objective at (12,7). Morrigan's Chosen charged Veche Levy 2 and Veche Levy 3 at (6,7); Veche Levy 3 failed its Fall Back test and broke away in disorder to (5,9).

Rurik's Regal Rogatina did 4 to the Tidebreaker (15 to 11) and PARALYZED it; the Rynda Guard added 2. Then Glandore turned three units on the Bogatyr Thunderguards: the Fey Lord (Magical Imbuement), Sidhe Wardens 2 (8) and Sidhe Wardens 1 (2): Bogatyr Thunderguards destroyed, and FOCUSED FIRE completed (+2, +1 CP). The Winter Witch survived on her 4+ invulnerable save and cast Hail of Heaven (4 Mana) on (7,6): 4 into Briton Yeomen 1, 1 into Sidhe Wardens 1, 4 into her own Veche Levy 2, CHILLED on all three. Morrigan's Chosen struck at INI 13 +3 with 10 hits and took Veche Levy 2 from 12 to 2. Veche Levy 1 shot Briton Yeomen 1 down to 5. Cliodhna channelled 5 Mana.
Glandore held all three objectives: the centre on OC 18 vs 2, the left on OC 9 vs 5, the right on OC 8 vs 0 (7 VP). 2-16.

3.title: The Winter Host takes the centre and the left back

feed.text: Glandore spent all 5 CP: Double Time for Briton Yeomen 1 (2) and Secure Objective for Sidhe Wardens 2 (3, it flipped nothing). The Winter Host spent 2 on Double Time for the Firelance Druzhina (bought nothing). Consumed By Blizzard CHILLED five Glandore units, and Veche Levy 2 failed Morale. Secondaries kept: ASSASSINATION and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY.

Veche Levy 1 charged Briton Yeomen 1 at (8,7), which broke away to (4,5). Veche Levy 2, on 2 HP, failed its Fall Back test from Morrigan's Chosen and was destroyed by the disorder. The Fomorian Tidebreaker broke away from Rurik to (2,6), and Rurik with the Rynda Guard charged the Fey Lord and Sidhe Wardens 2 at (1,8). Morrigan's Chosen charged Veche Levy 1 at (7,6). Sidhe Wardens 3 left the right objective for (10,6).

The Firelance Druzhina put 6 into the Tidebreaker (9 to 3). Morrigan's Chosen hit Veche Levy 1 for 8 (16 to 8). The Rynda Guard took Sidhe Wardens 2 to 1 HP before its FADING STEP took it to (3,6). Cliodhna cast Tonn Chliodhna (3 Mana) on (0,7): 8 into the Firelance Druzhina with the knockback, and Sidhe Wardens 3 finished the Druzhina (2). The Winter Witch used Overdraw for 3 Mana at the cost of 1 HP; Rurik's Lightning Discharge missed the Tidebreaker with all 5 dice.

The Winter Host won the centre on OC 12 vs 11 and the left on OC 11 vs 2 (5 VP), and IRON GRIP paid 2 and 1 CP. Nobody held the right. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid Glandore 2, 1 for each Winter Host objective with a Glandore unit in its area. 9-18.

4.title: Veche Levy 1 breaks; Cliodhna kills the Witch

feed.text: The Winter Host spent 2 CP on Double Time for the Winter Witch (her move to (5,9) needed it); Glandore spent 2 on Rally Cry via Cliodhna for Sidhe Wardens 1. Sidhe Wardens 2 failed Morale. Secondaries kept: LAST STAND and IRON GRIP.

Veche Levy 1, on 8 HP beside Morrigan's Chosen, Fell Back off the centre, failed the test and lost 3 more, ending at (8,10). Rurik and the Rynda Guard charged the Fomorian Tidebreaker and Briton Yeomen 1 at (1,6); the Tidebreaker failed its own Fall Back test and was destroyed by the 3 True Damage. Sidhe Wardens 3 returned to the right objective at (12,8). Sidhe Wardens 1 with Cliodhna charged the Winter Witch at (6,8), and Morrigan's Chosen charged Veche Levy 3.

The Winter Witch cast Morana's Judgement (6 Mana) on Sidhe Wardens 1: Sidhe Wardens 1 destroyed and 4 into Cliodhna (7 to 3). Morrigan's Chosen struck Veche Levy 3 first for 6 and stepped away; Briton Yeomen 2 and Sidhe Wardens 3 took Veche Levy 3 down to 3. Cliodhna's Tide-Crescent Glaive killed the Winter Witch (3), and Rurik finished Briton Yeomen 1 (2), after a shot from the Fey Lord had taken 2 off it (the digest marks it FRIENDLY FIRE) and the Rynda Guard 1 more. Sidhe Wardens 2's last shot missed the Rynda Guard under Go to Ground (1 CP).

Glandore took the centre on OC 17 vs 4 and the right on OC 8 (5 VP); the Winter Host held the left on OC 11. ERADICATE THE FOE paid the Winter Host 3 for two kills in Objective Areas. Glandore scored BREAK THEIR HOLD 3 (the centre was the Winter Host's at the start of the round), IRON GRIP 2 and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY 3, to 31. 14-31.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Glandore Breakers scored 17 objective VP: the centre and the left in Round 1, all three in Round 2, the centre and the right in Round 4. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 5 (Rounds 3 and 4) and four secondaries 9: INTO THE FRAY (2), FOCUSED FIRE (2), TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY (3) and IRON GRIP (2). The Winter Host scored 7 objective VP, all in Rounds 3 and 4, 3 from ERADICATE THE FOE in Round 4 and 4 from BAR THE GATES and IRON GRIP. The battle was settled by the first two rounds: 12 objective VP to none, and 16-2 on the board.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The Sidhe squads were first everywhere. Sidhe Wardens 1 with Cliodhna and Sidhe Wardens 2 with the Fey Lord reached the centre and the left in Round 1; Sidhe Wardens 3, a 17 RP squad, held the right in Rounds 2 and 4 and was Glandore's best scorer (7.2 VP, 4 of them hinged on it). Morrigan's Chosen did the most damage in the battle (24): INI 13 (+3 on the charge) and dual-wielded claws took Veche Levy 2 to 2 HP and Veche Levy 1 to 8, and both later died or broke falling back from it, though it never got a kill of its own. Cliodhna - The Dread Tide (65 RP) scored 5.1 VP, cast Tonn Chliodhna on the Firelance Druzhina and killed the Winter Witch.

For the Winter Host, the Winter Witch's Hail of Heaven and Morana's Judgement did 11 damage to Glandore (her 15 in the damage record includes the 4 Hail of Heaven put into Veche Levy 2), and Morana's Judgement killed Sidhe Wardens 1; and Veche Levy 1 (4.3 VP) carried the centre in Round 3. Rurik the Deathless and the Rynda Guard held the left in Rounds 3 and 4 but did 11 damage between them for 105 RP. The Bogatyr Thunderguards (40 RP) did 4 damage before three Glandore units shot them down in Round 2.

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Winter Host could not do

It could not reach the objectives in Round 1. Its infantry Advanced to rows 8 to 10 (the Rynda Guard and Veche Levy 1 rolled 3 Movement Points) while the Sidhe stood on row 7, and the Winter Host ended Round 1 with 10 OC against 17 in the centre and none on the left. When it did take two objectives in Round 3, BREAK THEIR HOLD paid Glandore for contesting them and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY was still open to Glandore in Round 4. ASSASSINATION (kept Round 3) never completed, though the Fomorian Tidebreaker, a MONSTER, died in Round 4 (see below), and LAST STAND needed an objective held with a unit below half-strength.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, and the record

  • Round 4, Veche Levy 1 Fell Back off the centre with 8 HP and lost 3 more in the disorder. The Fall Back record calls it costly: it gave up the centre's 3 VP, and the lost centre turned BREAK THEIR HOLD into 3 VP for Glandore. Glandore had 17 OC there, so the centre may have gone anyway.
  • Round 3, Sidhe Wardens 3 walked off the right objective to (10,6) and back on in Round 4 (the moves-undone record). Glandore scored no objective that round.
  • Round 4, the Fomorian Tidebreaker died to its own failed Fall Back from the Rynda Guard's charge. That death counted for the Winter Host's ERADICATE THE FOE (the scoring record's "unassigned 2") but not for its ASSASSINATION, which stayed active: secondaries skip a death with no attacker (missions/destroy_events.js) while the Primary's kill count does not. The two missions disagree about the same kill; the 4 VP would not have changed the result.
  • Commands-and-abilities record: the Round 2 Countercharge reads "nothing - no change", but it cancelled the Rynda Guard's charge and its charge completed INTO THE FRAY (2 VP); the Round 3 Overdraw reads "nothing" though the Mana record shows its +3, the same gap as Mint Privilege's CP.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated by charge-planning probes: Sidhe Wardens 1's "held" entries in Rounds 2 and 3 and Sidhe Wardens 2's in Round 4 name Veche Levy 2, Veche Levy 1 and the Rynda Guard as engagers while each stood two squares away.
  • Hail of Heaven's splash put 4 into the Winter Host's own Veche Levy 2, and the Double Times on Veche Levy 3 (Round 1) and the Firelance Druzhina (Round 3) bought nothing; so did Glandore's 3 CP Secure Objective.

The result looks like the armies' speed more than the AI. Both AIs gave ground away (Veche Levy 1's Fall Back, Sidhe Wardens 3's walk off the right), but Glandore's 12 VP head start from the first two rounds was more than the margin.

closing: Glandore Breakers' Sidhe stood on the centre and the left after one move and on all three objectives after two. The Winter Host fought its way back onto two of them in Round 3, but the lead was 16-2 by then. In Round 4 Glandore took the centre back and passed 30.
